downloadMethod: Official pinned Git tree confirmed the exact path. The connected GitHub read-only fetch_file tool returned the original binary as base64; decoded locally without altering the bytes. PowerShell HTTPS retrieval failed with an unexpected TLS receive error, so no elevated network permissions were requested.
verification: Decoded binary size equals the official Git tree size.
Binary begins with the wOF2 signature.
Git blob SHA1 computed from the decoded bytes equals the official tree blob SHA1.
Both local copies have the recorded SHA256.
Official pinned source-serif-variable.css declares italic style and weight range 200 900 for this exact binary.
prepareScript: scripts/prepare-redesign.cjs copies the reference binary to the isolated redesign font directory.
scope: Font binary preparation only. Shared CSS remains owned by the parent task. No website, server, browser, remote repository mutation or deployment.
